title: Can I BEAT Who Takes the Crown? (Influencer Levels)
summary: Return to 'Who Takes the Crown' (called 'Who Wears the Crown' in the intro), a 3D climbing game inspired by Bennett Foddy's Getting Over It: a little pawn character climbs a tower to claim a royal crown, and if you fail you fall all the way down. Each tower floor is a chessboard set to a position from a real game; you play out the position against an engine (e.g. a ~1300 Stockfish-level bot) and checkmates/wins earn 'jumps' used to move the pawn up to the next board. This video plays the Influencer boards: positions from XQC vs MoistCr1TiKaL (PogChamps, where XQC got mated on f2), Sardoche vs Ludwig, and others, sometimes as Black. He simplifies into winning endgames, promotes, and mates, while walking the pawn character across the pieces without falling off.
rules: Each level is a chessboard floor with a famous (here: influencer) game position; you play one side vs an engine from that position.

Winning (checkmate) clears the board; checkmates/achievements grant jumps; the number of jumps needed to reach the next floor is shown ('we'll need at least one jump, two jumps, and then we have the finish').
You physically control a pawn character walking/jumping on the boards and pieces; falling off drops you down the tower (Getting Over It style).
Standard chess rules within each board.
win_condition: Checkmate the engine on each board and climb to the top to claim the crown.
